我的宠物 · 宠物列表
My pets · Pet list
管理每一位家庭成员。
Manage every family member.
显示当前演示账号的宠物，连接宠物详情、建档和关联设备。
Shows pets of current demo account, connects pet details, profile creation and device linking.
• 点击宠物卡查看详情；点击添加宠物填写资料。
• Tap pet card to view details; tap Add pet to fill in info.
• 新增、编辑或删除后，首页和健康页的宠物选择同步更新。
• After add, edit or delete, pet selection on Home and Health pages updates in sync.

宠物资料保存在当前浏览器；删除前需要确认，并解除演示设备关联。

宠物建档 · 新增与编辑
Pet profile · Add & edit
按评审截图重建的 Add Pet 表单。
Add Pet form rebuilt per review screenshot.
改为 3 个标签卡的分步流程：① Connect device（扫码绑定 / 选择已有设备 / 暂不绑定）；② Pet profile（犬种照片+名称选择、两列 10 字段、新增下次疫苗接种时间）；③ Photos（8 角度照片）→ 完成提示 → 进入 Home。顶部标签卡可点击回跳。

Changed to 3-tab step wizard: ① Connect device (scan bind / choose existing device / bind later); ② Pet profile (breed photo + name select, two-column 10 fields, added next vaccination time); ③ Photos (8 angle photos) → done hint → enter Home. Top tabs clickable to jump back.
• 步骤①：选 Scan 后点 Scan QR code 自动填入示例 IMEI；标题与说明已改为“Scan a device or genetic test box”，可扫描设备或基因检测盒子；选 Use an existing device 从下拉挑设备，若设备已绑定其他宠物会弹窗询问是否变更主人；也可选 I'll link a device later 跳过。

• Step ①: choose Scan then tap Scan QR code to auto-fill sample IMEI; title and desc changed to "Scan a device or genetic test box", can scan device or genetic test box; choose Use an existing device to pick from dropdown, if device already bound to other pet a dialog asks whether to change owner; also can choose I'll link a device later to skip.
• 步骤②：点“小型 / 中型 / 大型”快速筛选可切换相关尺寸的犬种卡片；点犬种照片卡自动填入 Breed；字段校验宠物名与体重必填。
• Step ②: tap Small / Medium / Large quick filter to switch breed cards of corresponding size; tap breed photo card to auto-fill Breed; field validation requires Pet name and Weight.
• 步骤③：点击虚线照片框选本地图片预览；新建时必须凑齐 8 张才能保存，编辑已有宠物时不重复要求。
• Step ③: tap dashed photo box to select local image for preview; new pet must have all 8 photos to save, editing existing pet does not repeat requirement.
• Save & Finish 后显示 All set! 完成页，点 Go to Home 进入首页；设备绑定/主人变更在保存时生效。
• After Save & Finish shows All set! done page, tap Go to Home to enter Home; device binding / owner change takes effect on save.

演示范围

照片仅保存在当前浏览器会话，使用 blob URL 预览，不上传服务器；犬种照片使用现有示例狗图，仅用于演示选择交互。App 内文案按项目约定使用英文，参考截图为中文界面。

Demo scope

Photos only saved in current browser session, preview via blob URL, not uploaded to server; breed photos use existing sample dog images, for demo selection interaction only. App text follows project convention in English, reference screenshot is Chinese UI.

宠物详情
Pet details
围绕一只宠物查看资料和设备。
View info and devices around one pet.
聚合宠物基础信息、健康记录、关联设备与编辑入口。关联设备按该宠物过滤：Lucky 2 台、Milo 1 台、Coco 无设备（显示 No devices linked yet.）。
Aggregates pet basic info, health records, linked devices and edit entry. Linked devices filtered by this pet: Lucky 2 units, Milo 1 unit, Coco no devices (shows No devices linked yet.).
• 编辑资料、进入健康页、查看健康记录。
• Edit info, enter health page, view health records.
• Genetic Test：跟踪基因检测并在线查看报告；Vaccination records：查看接种记录与下次接种时间。
• Genetic Test: track genetic test and view report online; Vaccination records: view vaccination records and next vaccination time.
• 点击关联设备查看详情；删除宠物前确认，删除后回到宠物列表。
• Tap linked device to view details; confirm before delete pet, returns to pet list after delete.

演示范围

Genetic Test 基因检测
Genetic Test
扫码试剂盒，跟踪检测状态，在线查看报告。
Scan kit, track detection status, view report online.
按当前宠物展示基因检测记录，状态分为 Sample submitted（送检中）、Testing in progress（检测中，只读）、Report ready（报告可查看）。
Shows genetic test records by current pet, status divided into Sample submitted (submitted), Testing in progress (testing, read-only), Report ready (report viewable).
• Add Genetic Test：扫码 → 宠物基本信息（可编辑）→ 确认生成送检中记录。
• Add Genetic Test: scan → Pet basic info (editable) → confirm to generate submitted record.
• 送检中可录入物流单号；检测中不可编辑；报告就绪后可在线查看 Genetic Test Report。
• Submitted status can enter tracking number; Testing status not editable; after Report ready can view Genetic Test Report online.

演示范围

两个 Simulate 按钮用于演示状态流转，非真实送检；数据仅本地保存。报告为示例，不构成医疗诊断。

Demo scope

Two Simulate buttons for demo status transition, not real submission; data saved locally only. Report is sample, does not constitute medical diagnosis.
